GetTheListOfClusterNodeGroupsV2.pageNo: Page number for query. Returns all node groups when pageNo or pageSize is 0
GetTheListOfClusterNodeGroupsV2.pageSize: Number of entries per page. Returns all node groups when pageNo or pageSize is 0
GetTheListOfClusterNodeGroupsV2.keywordType: Keyword search type. Options: [ instanceGroupName, instanceGroupID ]
GetTheListOfClusterNodeGroupsV2.keyword: Search keyword, used together with keywordType
GetTheListOfClusterNodeGroupsV2.autoscalerEnabled: Filter by autoscaling status. Set to true to return only node groups with autoscaling enabled
GetTheListOfClusterNodeGroupsV2.chargingType: Filter by billing method. Options: [ Prepaid, Postpaid, bidding ]
